zh.title: AE2 联邦组网
zh.name: 联邦组网
zh.tagline: 多个 ME 网络，各自独立，按需共享。
zh.hero_body:
每个网络保留自己的频道、控制器和合成 CPU，
只共享你打开的部分：存储和合成按方向开放，ME 能量可以两个网络共用。
zh.hero_alt: 基地、市场、锯木厂三个 ME 网络通过一个交换机连在一起
zh.hero_switch: 交换机 · 把三个网络接入联邦
zh.hero_caption: 线缆颜色区分网络。这些场景都能在游戏内指南里 3D 旋转查看。
zh.storage_alt: 一个仓库网络和两个工坊网络通过交换机相连
zh.storage_title:
一个仓库，
几座工坊都能存取。
zh.storage_body: 每座工坊都是独立的网络，频道互不占用，终端却能直接存取仓库里的库存。电源只接在仓库上，工坊跟着用。
zh.legend_warehouse: ：驱动器，以及给这里所有网络供电的能源元件
zh.legend_workshop: ：各有一个终端，靠仓库的电源运行
zh.rules_alt: 游戏内拓扑图与共享规则面板
zh.rules_caption: 游戏内界面 · 在拓扑图上选中两个网络：存储和合成按方向分别开关，ME 能量两个网络共用
zh.orders_title: 合成和加工，都能交给另一个网络。
zh.order_body: 另一位玩家的网络向你的工厂下单，用自己的原料付账。工厂只共享配方，驱动器里的库存对方看不到。
zh.order_alt: 顾客网络通过联邦桥连接工厂网络
zh.furnace_body: 在主网络上请求石头，熔炉各自在自己的小网络里烧。处理样板留在主网络，不用设任何共享规则。
zh.furnace_alt: 主网络的联邦样板供应器把原料送到两座熔炉的处理端点
zh.mapping_alt: 游戏内样板与处理端点映射界面
zh.mapping_caption: 游戏内界面 · 样板与处理端点的映射
zh.mapping_body: 把样板拖到处理端点上就建立映射，一个样板可以对应多个处理端点。
zh.mapping_point:
每次只送出当前任务的原料，
主网络的仓库不对外开放。
zh.outpost_title: 下界前哨，用主世界的仓库和电。
zh.outpost_body: 前哨是一个独立的网络，有自己的频道，用的却是主世界基地的存储和电源。两个维度之间，靠量子网络桥上的一对联邦 P2P 通道相连。
zh.overworld_alt: 主世界的基地、工厂与量子网络桥
zh.nether_alt: 下界的量子网络桥与前哨网络
zh.overview_body: 网络怎么连、共享了什么、物品流向哪里，在游戏里就能查。
zh.topology_alt: 游戏内拓扑视图，显示网络、联邦域和网络详情
zh.topology_caption: 拓扑：网络、联邦域、共享方向，以及选中网络的详情
zh.statistics_alt: 游戏内统计视图，显示网络之间的物品流动
zh.statistics_caption: 统计：库存、传输、电力、合成与频道，可回看 2 分钟到 24 小时的游戏时间
zh.download: 下载 AE2 联邦组网
zh.download_hint: 在 CurseForge 搜索 AE2 Federation
zh.requires: 需要 Applied Energistics 2 与 LDLib2 · MC 1.21.1 NeoForge

en.title: AE2 Federation
en.name: Federation
en.tagline: Separate ME networks that share only what you choose.
en.hero_body: Each network keeps its own channels, controller and crafting CPUs. Storage and crafting are opened one direction at a time, and two networks can run on shared ME energy.
en.hero_alt: A district, a market and a sawmill: three ME networks joined by one Switch
en.hero_caption: Cable colours tell the networks apart. Every scene here can be rotated in 3D in the in-game guide.
en.storage_alt: A warehouse network and two workshop networks joined by a Switch
en.storage_title:
One warehouse,
every workshop uses it.
en.storage_body: Each workshop is a network of its own and keeps its own channels, yet its terminal stores into and takes from the warehouse stock. Only the warehouse needs power; the workshops run on it.
en.legend_warehouse: : drives, and the energy cell that powers every network here
en.legend_workshop: : a terminal each, running on the warehouse's power
en.rules_alt: The in-game topology view with its sharing-rule panel
en.rules_caption: In-game UI · select two networks on the topology: storage and crafting switch per direction, ME energy is shared by both
en.orders_title: Send crafting and processing to another network.
en.order_body: Another player's network orders from your factory and pays with its own items. The factory shares only its recipes; its drive stays private.
en.order_alt: A customer network joined to a factory network by a Bridge
en.furnace_body: Order stone on your main network while each furnace smelts on a small network of its own. The processing pattern stays on the main network, and no rule is needed.
en.furnace_alt: A Federation Pattern Provider on the main network sends ingredients to the Processing Endpoints of two furnaces
en.mapping_alt: The in-game view that maps patterns to Processing Endpoints
en.mapping_caption: In-game UI · patterns mapped to Processing Endpoints
en.mapping_body: Drag a pattern onto a Processing Endpoint to map it. One pattern can map to several endpoints.
en.mapping_point: Only the current job's ingredients are sent out. The main network's storage stays closed.
en.outpost_title: A Nether outpost on Overworld storage and power.
en.outpost_body: The outpost is a network of its own with its own channels, yet it uses the storage and power of your base in the Overworld. A pair of Federation P2P tunnels over a Quantum Network Bridge links the two dimensions.
en.overworld_alt: The base, a factory and the Quantum Network Bridge in the Overworld
en.nether_alt: The Quantum Network Bridge and the outpost network in the Nether
en.overview_title: The whole federation on one screen.
en.overview_body: How networks connect, what they share and where items go: you can check all of it in game.
en.topology_alt: The in-game topology view with networks, federation domains and network details
en.topology_caption: Topology: networks, federation domains, sharing directions and the selected network's details
en.statistics_alt: The in-game statistics view with item flow between networks
en.statistics_caption: Statistics: stock, transfers, power, crafting and channels, over 2 minutes to 24 hours of game time
en.download_hint: Search for AE2 Federation on CurseForge
en.requires: Requires Applied Energistics 2 and LDLib2 · MC 1.21.1 NeoForge
